strings.إذا تدور صباغ بالكويت، خصّص وقتًا لطريقة: If Sabbagh rotates in Kuwait, make time for how you pick up the job from the beginning. Previous work photos help you visualize the result, but your home has its details: corners, frames, extensions and restoration places. A simple checklist leaves you understanding with the contractor on the desired, and you notice the things that need to be modified and are yet easy to access.

strings.الفكرة إنك تعرف شنو تراجع بكل مرحلة، وتف: The idea is that you know what went down in each phase, separating an implementation note from a new change you’ve decided to add while working.
strings.قبل البداية: وثّق وضع المكان: Before the beginning: document the situation of the place
strings.صوّر الجدران كاملة، وبعدها خذ صورًا قريب: Take full pictures of the walls, and then take close-up photos of the damaged areas and edges. Select rooms, ceilings, and parts that go into work, and record things that need to stay where they are or need special protection. Photographing the current situation helps both parties return to the same reference if there is a difference on an old damage or a new note.
strings.دوّن اسم الدهان المحدد وكود اللون واللمع: Without the name of the specific paint, color code and gloss for each space. The phrase “the same lounge” can cause confusion if you have more than one degree. You can use a list of room names and under each room approved materials and details.
strings.تابع التجهيز قبل ما يختفي تحت اللون: Continue processing before it disappears under the color.
strings.اطلب تشوف مواضع المعالجة قبل الانتقال لل: Ask to see where the treatment is before moving to paint. Review the holes agreed to be closed, the effects of old additions, and the boundaries of areas that need to be settled. Do not change the scope of the treatment verbally and leave the details to remember; record any addition and agree on its impact at work.

strings.رتّب جولة مشتركة بعد مدة الجفاف المناسبة: Arrange a joint tour after the appropriate drying period for the product, and before returning the furniture to its place. Run the usual room lighting and review the walls from more than one direction. Be clear in the description of the note and its location:
strings.هل اللون واللمعة مطابقان للاعتماد المكتو: Does the color and gloss match the written adoption?
strings.هل توجد مساحات ناقصة التغطية أو آثار سيل: Are there areas that are under-covered or obvious runny effects?
strings.هل حدود الدهان عند السقف والإطارات مرتبة: Are the paint limits at ceiling and frames arranged?
strings.هل المقابس والأبواب والأرضيات خالية من ب: Are the sockets, doors and floors free of execution stains?
strings.هل مواضع الترميم المتفق عليها مكتملة؟: Are the agreed restoration sites complete?
strings.إذا لاحظت فرقًا، صوّره وحدّد موقعه بدل إ: If you notice a difference, photograph it and locate it instead of sending a close-up image that is hard to tell where it is. Also agree on the inspection conditions and the level of finishing expected from the start, especially for walls with strong sidelights.
strings.رقّم الملاحظات غرفة غرفة، وحدّد مع المنف: No. Room notes, specify with the contractor how they are processed and when to review them. The difference between a defect that needs correction and your desire to change color after it is approved. Before closing the workpiece, ask for the data of the materials used and the appropriate care instructions for them.
